Sell Value - one fish, step by step: Mirrors Roll.Value + Inventory.SellValue. The game stores each catch's value at catch time, then multiplies by the Sell Multiplier x Coin boost x Hot-fish multiplier when sold.
Catch multiplier (manual 1.5 + perfect 0.25, or Auto stat)
Value stored in the bag at catch time
Sale multiplier = Sell Multiplier x Coin boost
Coins when sold = stored x sale multiplier x hot-fish
Note: the shop sums stored values per stack then multiplies, so per-fish rounding can differ by a few coins in big stacks.
